{{Youmay|the [[Yapi]] tribe|the [[Immobilizer 418 Interdictor-class Heavy Cruiser|Immobilizer 418 cruiser]] ''[[Red Claw]]''}}
The '''Red Claw''' were a tribe of [[Yapi]] who lived close to [[DarkStryder's Fortress]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Kathol (planet)|Kathol]]. Their [[Shaman/Legends|shaman]], [[Speaker (Yapi)|Speaker]], helped to broker an alliance of Yapi tribes and other [[Species/Legends|species]], to assist the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] crew of the ''[[FarStar]]'' in their fight against [[DarkStryder]] and [[Moff/Legends|Moff]] [[Kentor Sarne]].
